name: Structured Document Extractor
description: Extract structured fields from any document type using an LLM — one component, document_type picks the preset (invoice, receipt, resume, ...) or 'custom' for your own fields.

inputs.description: Input DataFrame with a column of document text or file paths -- omit when using `path` (this component lists files itself instead)

outputs.description: Enriched DataFrame with the extracted fields as new columns

upstream_asset_key.label: Upstream Asset Key
upstream_asset_key.description: Upstream asset key providing a DataFrame with document content. Mutually exclusive with `path` -- set exactly one.

path.label: Path / Glob
path.description: Glob pattern or fsspec URI to list documents from directly (s3://, gs://, abfss:// / abfs:// / az://, or a local path). Mutually exclusive with `upstream_asset_key` -- set exactly one. No separate file_lister asset needed.

download.label: Download
download.description: When using `path`: download each matched file to a local cache directory first. Ignored when using `upstream_asset_key`.

download_dir.label: Download Directory
download_dir.description: When using `path` with download=true: local cache directory. Auto-generated under the system temp dir if unset.

max_files.label: Max Files
max_files.description: When using `path`: safety cap on how many matched files to process in one materialize.

document_type.label: Document Type
document_type.description: Picks a default output_fields preset, or 'custom' (requires output_fields to be set explicitly).

input_column.label: Input Column
input_column.description: Column with document content (text or file path) — 'local_path' pairs directly with file_lister's output.

input_type.label: Input Type
input_type.description: Input type: 'text' (raw document text already in the column) or 'file' (read the file at that path).

api_key_env_var.label: Api Key Env Var
api_key_env_var.description: Environment variable name holding the API key

output_fields.label: Output Fields
output_fields.description: Fields to extract from each document. Overrides the document_type preset when set. Required when document_type='custom'.

batch_size.label: Batch Size
batch_size.description: Number of documents per LLM batch

llm_max_retries.label: LLM Max Retries
llm_max_retries.description: Retry a document's LLM call up to this many times on transient errors (rate limits, timeouts) before giving up on that row -- forwarded to litellm's own num_retries.

max_content_chars.label: Max Content Chars
max_content_chars.description: Truncate extracted document text to this many characters before prompting the LLM -- guards against blowing the model's context window or racking up cost on unusually large text-PDF/text-input rows. Doesn't apply to image rows (sent as a vision content block, not text). Set to null to disable.

field_regions.label: Field Regions
field_regions.description: Optional per-field bounding boxes (fractional 0-1 x/y/width/height) marking where each field appears on the document -- only meaningful for image documents, silently ignored for PDF/text. Each region is cropped and sent to the LLM as a labeled close-up hint alongside the full image.

post_process.label: Post Process
post_process.description: What to do with each SOURCE file once it's been successfully extracted: 'none' (leave in place -- files get reprocessed every run), 'move' (to post_process_dir), or 'delete'. Only applied to successfully-extracted rows; a failed row's file is left in place so the next run retries it. Requires input_type='file'.

post_process_dir.label: Post Process Directory
post_process_dir.description: Destination directory when post_process='move'. Same fsspec scheme as the source file. Required when post_process='move'.

description.label: Description
description.description: Asset description shown in the Dagster catalog.

owners.label: Owners
owners.description: Asset owners — list of team names or email addresses, e.g. ['team:analytics', 'user@company.com']

asset_tags.label: Asset Tags
asset_tags.description: Additional key-value tags to apply to the asset, e.g. {'domain': 'finance', 'tier': 'gold'}

kinds.label: Kinds
kinds.description: Asset kinds for the Dagster catalog. Auto-inferred from component name if not set.

freshness_max_lag_minutes.label: Freshness Max Lag Minutes
freshness_max_lag_minutes.description: Maximum acceptable lag in minutes before the asset is considered stale.

freshness_cron.label: Freshness Cron
freshness_cron.description: Cron schedule string for the freshness policy, e.g. '0 9 * * 1-5'.

include_preview_metadata.label: Include Preview Metadata
include_preview_metadata.description: Include a preview of the output data in metadata (first rows as markdown table).

preview_rows.label: Preview Rows
preview_rows.description: Rows to include in the preview metadata when include_preview_metadata is True.

column_lineage.label: Column Lineage
column_lineage.description: Column-level lineage mapping: output column name → list of upstream column names it was derived from.

deps.label: Deps
deps.description: Lineage-only upstream asset keys (no data passed at runtime).

partition_type.label: Partition Type
partition_type.description: Enable partitioning: 'daily', 'weekly', 'monthly', 'hourly' for time-based; 'static' for a fixed set of values; 'multi' for date × static. Leave empty for unpartitioned.

partition_start.label: Partition Start Date
partition_start.description: ISO date string for the first partition, e.g. '2024-01-01'.

partition_date_column.label: Partition Date Column
partition_date_column.description: Column used to filter upstream DataFrame to the current date partition key.

partition_dimensions.label: Partition Dimensions
partition_dimensions.description: Multi-axis partition spec. Overrides flat fields when set.

partition_values.label: Partition Values
partition_values.description: Comma-separated values for static or multi partitioning.

partition_static_dim.label: Partition Static Dim
partition_static_dim.description: Dimension name for the static axis in multi-partitioning.

partition_static_column.label: Partition Static Column
partition_static_column.description: Column used to filter upstream DataFrame to the current static partition dimension.

retry_policy_max_retries.label: Retry Policy Max Retries
retry_policy_max_retries.description: Max retries on asset failure. Defines a RetryPolicy.
